title: Intracompany transfer before plant supply
story: One distributor is long in TX (200 days) and nearly out in FL (3 days). Move 320 cases TX to FL: enough to take FL to the run plus buffer (35 days x 10 = 350, minus 30 on hand). FL is then covered, so its plant order is held, and all 200 plant cases go to the other distributor. The transfer itself goes to approval.
